faqs.question: How much does flea treatment cost in Hicksville?
faqs.answer: Flea treatment in Hicksville — pricing depends on the size of your property, severity of infestation, and number of treatments required. We provide free phone consultations and detailed quotes with no hidden fees before starting any work.

faqs.question: How long does flea treatment take to work?
faqs.answer: Most clients see a significant reduction in flea activity within 24-48 hours after treatment. However, due to the flea life cycle, complete elimination typically requires 2-3 weeks and may need follow-up treatments to ensure all eggs and larvae are eliminated.

faqs.question: Is flea treatment safe for my pets and children in Hicksville?
faqs.answer: Yes, we use EPA-registered products that are safe for pets and children when applied correctly. We recommend keeping pets and children away from treated areas for 2-4 hours until surfaces dry completely. Our technicians will provide specific safety instructions during your service.

faqs.question: What happens if I still see pests after service?
faqs.answer: If you still notice pest activity after your service, call us and we'll come back to reassess — next steps depend on the service and are confirmed on the call.
